content.title: Elanco CEO Bites Off More Shares of Fast-Rising Stock
content.summary: Elanco Animal Health  stock is having a great year—and Chief Executive Jeffrey Simmons is champing at the bit.  Simmons spent $478,500 to buy 22,000 shares of the stock on Dec. 11 for an average price of $21.75, according to a Form 4 filed with the Securities and Exchange Commission.  The purchase was made by a revocable trust and brings his total indirect ownership to 167,000 shares.
